title: BIOL 210: Genetics and Genomes
text:
BIOL 210 - Genetics and Genomes
Sample University, Department of Biology
Winter 2027

Week-by-week schedule
Week 1: Mendelian genetics, Punnett squares, test crosses
Week 2: Chromosomes and linkage, recombination, gene mapping
Week 3: DNA as genetic material, replication, repair of DNA damage
Week 4: Gene expression: transcription, RNA processing, translation
Week 5: Regulation of gene expression in bacteria (the lac operon) and in eukaryotes
Week 6: Mutations and their effects. Reading week at the end of this week.
Week 7: Population genetics and Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
Week 8: Genomics, sequencing technologies, and CRISPR gene editing

Assessments
Problem set 1 is worth 8% and is due at the end of week 3.
Problem set 2 is worth 8% and is due in week 6 (exact day to be announced).
Lab report: 12%, due Monday, March 1, 2027, 5:00 PM.
Midterm: 30%, held in the week after reading week. Date TBA.
Final exam: 42%, exam period (date to be announced).

concepts.label: Mendelian inheritance
concepts.summary: Traits are passed on by discrete alleles that segregate according to predictable ratios.

concepts.label: Punnett squares
concepts.summary: A grid tool for predicting offspring genotype and phenotype ratios from a cross.

concepts.label: Test crosses
concepts.summary: Crossing an individual with a homozygous recessive to reveal its unknown genotype.

concepts.label: Linkage and recombination
concepts.summary: Genes on the same chromosome tend to be inherited together unless recombination separates them.

concepts.label: Gene mapping
concepts.summary: Using recombination frequencies to estimate the order and distance of genes on a chromosome.

concepts.label: DNA as genetic material
concepts.summary: DNA carries hereditary information from one generation to the next.

concepts.label: DNA replication
concepts.summary: The cell copies its DNA before division so each daughter cell gets a full genome.

concepts.label: DNA damage repair
concepts.summary: Cellular mechanisms that detect and fix damage to DNA.

concepts.label: Transcription
concepts.summary: RNA is synthesized from a DNA template.

concepts.label: RNA processing
concepts.summary: Newly made RNA is modified into mature RNA before translation.

concepts.label: Translation
concepts.summary: Ribosomes read mRNA to build a protein.

concepts.label: Lac operon regulation
concepts.summary: Bacteria control lactose-metabolism genes as a group in response to the environment.

concepts.label: Eukaryotic gene regulation
concepts.summary: Eukaryotic cells control when and how much each gene is expressed.

concepts.label: Mutations and effects
concepts.summary: Changes in DNA sequence can alter gene function in different ways.

concepts.label: Population genetics
concepts.summary: The study of how allele frequencies vary and change in populations.

concepts.label: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
concepts.summary: A model predicting stable allele and genotype frequencies when no evolutionary forces act.

concepts.label: Sequencing technologies
concepts.summary: Methods for reading DNA sequences and analyzing whole genomes.

concepts.label: CRISPR gene editing
concepts.summary: A tool for making targeted changes to DNA sequences.
